# viettelcloud_lb_loadbalancer (Resource)

Manage a Viettel Cloud Load Balancer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "viettelcloud_vpc" "example" {
  name        = "my-lb-vpc"
  cidr        = "10.20.0.0/16"
  region      = { name = "vn-central-1" }
  description = "VPC for a Load Balancer"
}

resource "viettelcloud_lb_loadbalancer" "example" {
  name        = "my-load-balancer"
  description = "Managed by Terraform"
  package     = "SMALL"
  topology    = "SINGLE"
  region      = { name = "vn-central-1" }
  vpc         = { id = viettelcloud_vpc.example.id }

  # Assign a public IPv4 address. Omit it to keep public IP off.
  public_ip_mode = "ipv4-only"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Load Balancer.
- `package` (String) Load Balancer package: SMALL, MEDIUM, or LARGE.
- `region` (Attributes) Project region where the Load Balancer is created. Changing the region replaces the Load Balancer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--region))
- `topology` (String) Load Balancer topology: SINGLE or ACTIVE_STANDBY.
- `vpc` (Attributes) VPC where the Load Balancer is created. Changing the VPC replaces the Load Balancer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vpc))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description. Omission preserves the backend value. Set an empty string to clear it.
- `private_ip` (Attributes) Private IP to use as the VIP. When omitted during creation, the backend allocates one and reports it in `private_ip_id`. Later omission keeps the Load Balancer. Configuring a Private IP other than `private_ip_id` replaces the Load Balancer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--private_ip))
- `public_ip_mode` (String) Public IP mode of the Load Balancer: `ipv4-only` assigns a public IPv4 address, and `dual-stack` assigns a public IPv4 and a public IPv6 address. Set the mode that the region supports. Omitting it turns public IP off, also on a Load Balancer whose public IP was assigned outside Terraform or before this attribute existed, so configure the current mode to keep an existing public IP, including after import. Changes apply in place without replacing the Load Balancer. A `dual-stack` Load Balancer cannot change to `ipv4-only` unless the region changes too.
- `qos_policy` (Attributes) QoS policy assigned during creation. Later omission keeps the Load Balancer. Configuring a QoS policy other than `qos_policy_id` replaces the Load Balancer. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--qos_policy))
- `type` (String) Load Balancer type: appliance or native. When omitted during creation, the backend uses appliance. Later omission keeps the backend value. Changing a configured type replaces the Load Balancer.

### Read-Only

- `access_log_enabled` (Boolean) Whether access logging is enabled.
- `access_log_store_id` (String) ID (UUID) of the access log store. Null when the Load Balancer has no access log store.
- `access_log_store_name` (String) Name of the access log store. Null when the Load Balancer has no access log store.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the Load Balancer was created (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Load Balancer ID (UUID).
- `private_ip_id` (String) ID (UUID) of the Private IP that holds the VIP. Null when the API reports no association.
- `provisioning_status` (String) Current provisioning status.
- `public_address` (String) Public IPv4 address. Null when the Load Balancer has no public IPv4 address.
- `qos_policy_id` (String) ID (UUID) of the assigned QoS policy. Null when the API reports no association.
- `qos_policy_name` (String) Name of the assigned QoS policy.
- `region_id` (String) Region ID (UUID).
- `status` (String) Current operating status.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the Load Balancer was last updated (RFC3339).
- `v6_public_address` (String) Public IPv6 address. Null when the Load Balancer has no public IPv6 address.
- `vip_address` (String) Private VIP address.
- `vpc_name` (String) Name of the VPC containing the Load Balancer.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a Load Balancer by ID.
terraform import viettelcloud_lb_loadbalancer.example 6f1a2c3d-4e5b-6789-abcd-ef0123456789
```
